name: list-events
description: Lists the events (meetings, appointments) on a Google Calendar in a time window, by default the week ahead (the next seven days from now), optionally filtered by free text: what is on the calendar, upcoming or past, with each event's id, title, times, location, organizer and attendees. calendarId defaults to "primary"; google-calendar__list-calendars supplies others. The event id is the eventId google-calendar__get-event, google-calendar__update-event, google-calendar__delete-event and google-calendar__respond-to-event take.

calendarId.description: Calendar ID to list. Defaults to 'primary'; use list-calendars to obtain other calendar IDs.

timeMin.description: RFC 3339 lower time bound. Defaults to the current time.

timeMax.description: RFC 3339 upper time bound. Defaults to seven days after timeMin.

query.description: Free-text search passed to Google Calendar as q.

maxResults.description: Maximum total number of events to return. Defaults to 50.
